One thing that I wholeheartedly believe is that there are two separate set of laws in any given country. There are laws for the landed gentry where they are protected by money, status and power. Then there are the laws for you and I. These laws are not relative. The power players of the world do not have to abide by law. We do. People are losing their jobs, their families, their livelihood due to a very vocal minority. Our politicians are embroiled in scandal after scandal and are rarely (if ever) held culpable for their actions. Judges, police, corporations and representatives do not represent the people any longer. They represent personal interest. They rarely care about injustice.

This sub exists to share those injustices.

When I was on Reddit I would often see articles posted about a judge handing down a fierce sentence on a victimless crime or a cop getting away with an obvious murder. We would all share our dissatisfaction but that's where we'd stop. We would discuss why a sentence was heinous, but that's as far as we were willing to go. Often times in those topics I would always try to take it a step further. I would write out an e-mail and share it in the comments along with names, phone numbers, Twitter accounts, relevant links or addresses to allow people to get into contact with their Congressmen or State Reps to get their voices heard.
